title: Specify and implement bounded engine session and mutation contracts
scope: Owned buffers, frames/IDs, revisions/epochs, error and history/job lane contracts before command integration.
acceptance: Original-derived successful/refused state traces specify transitions, epoch/revision and late completion behavior.
Native/Wasm contract tests and explicit downstream ownership; no duplicate business-state store.

evidence.summary: Second-pass implementation boundaries and concrete next runtime/source tests; no new runtime or acceptance claim.

open_items: Scoped runtime libraries, retained reactions and registered mutation/interrupt dispatch now compose with history/activity/current/error normalization (engine.runtime.guarded, PR #99). Next engine.runtime.readonly completes read-only and remembered job dispatch. Real scan/family document ownership, platform timers/ingress, import/plane/undo/project/CLI and browser engine runtime remain required. No whole-session acceptance.

Scoped registry/history/queues/deadline/settle/plugin/stale/error/clock/execute/recent/workspace/label/activity/readout libraries and native task ownership exist. engine.runtime.reactions now connects retained source-boundary deadline/execute/scene callers; full guarded/interrupt/history/native family ownership, real timers/late progress/commands/projects/CLI/browser runtime remain required. Next unit engine.runtime.guarded; no session acceptance.
Reuse the implemented engine.error.envelope; do not duplicate codes or replace UTF16 wire messages with lossy Display text.

2026-11-02: owner handed implementation to Codex after #42/#43/#44 integration. First bounded child engine.session.registry ports actual registration/catalog/admission; parent remains specified until complete scheduling/history/worker/staged-import traces exist.
